summary:
Source inventory of nine public owning repositories at the cited immutable revisions, including literate Markdown; this is a navigation index, not a new model run, runtime qualification, fleet census or work selection. Consumers own domain models and projections. Retrieve platform/fsquint-owner, coordination/fsquint-test-production-joins, repo/fsquint/overview and fsquint/automata-qualified-and-deferred-scope for the established package and acceptance boundaries. Source, historical acceptance and present installed use remain separate.

- [Shared experiments](https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/tree/eebd3a25b841a15831cd6ded2593e8d0eb808ac6/docs/quint): Combat consequences and communication-network .qnt models live under docs/quint. ADR-0077 selects literate Quint as the target Typed SDD authority and generated contracts as integration projections; its target decision alone does not prove each consumer migrated.
- [Generic replay and examples](https://github.com/FS-GG/FsQuint/tree/48cf3075914583f9830e49a2f400678f1546024d/examples): BoundedQueue models FIFO behavior; AutomataReplay contains approval, turnstile, resolver, correction and durable protocol models with tests; CiPreflight models pipeline ordering. ITF decoding/replay is generic, with caller-owned real-state input bindings and projections. Automata provider evidence is a separate opt-in tier. Exporters, finite callback exploration, shared IR/code generation and arbitrary historical validation remain deferred under the cited expansion decision.
- [Workspace lifecycle](https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.SDD/tree/cec249fe6d4aa3dac1722999bb094fa3998ac70f/src/FS.GG.SDD.Artifacts/TypedSpecifications/QuintAssets/workspace-lifecycle.md): The literate source owns revision-bound proposal filing, classification and acceptance; extraction produces a .qnt projection. Additional literate fixtures live under tests/fixtures/quint-general-sir, quint-neutral-authority and quint-retained-reducer. docs/experiments/quint-q1/slices holds requirements/evidence, S.I.R. damage and coordination-process candidate models; the Q1 experiment remains distinct from production authority. Generic replay delegates through the FsQuint compatibility facade.
- [Coordination protocol](https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Coordination/tree/05e38c5be9b8f7edde87cd9b94974f10a63b759b/src/FS.GG.Coordination.Protocol/Protocol.md): The canonical literate protocol covers vocabulary, revision-bound authority, observations, retained streams, mutations, durable plans and qualification. work/26-canonical-quint-protocol/specification.md and Host.Tests/Fixtures/Choreo/HistoricalProtocol.md are additional literate historical surfaces. Test replay uses FsQuint; production Qualification.Contracts retains the separately locked SDD.Artifacts kernel. Neither a model nor a test join grants network-writer authority or establishes production migration.
- [Game and WASM](https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Game/tree/4163448cfc69d428e136853212765690265b92c6/eng/wasm-shared): lifecycle.qnt models supervisor state, worker generations, requests and ordered effects; compatible-, event-boundary- and expiry-qualification.qnt cover connected bounded qualification cases. readiness/svg-network-01-1, svg-replay-01-3 and svg-runtime-01-2 retain networkAdmission, energyRules and sessionOperations .qnt witnesses. Model correspondence does not establish engine startup, native useful play, container containment or clean installed receiver acceptance.
- [Rendering reducers](https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Rendering/tree/d73e17ba529ef22f0d5155bdceac8ece68aeb3ef/models): Literate input-command/input-command.md, svg-foundation/retained-interaction.md and svg-runtime/external-session.md model portable command resolution, retained SVG interaction/document replacement and presentation-only external session ownership. readiness/svg-input-01-2 and svg-qual-01-2 hold derived .qnt evidence. Input clocks/browser delivery, exhaustive or temporal liveness, floating-point camera equivalence, and external engine/transport semantics stay outside the respective bounded models.
- [Generated workspace examples](https://github.com/FS-GG/FS.GG.Templates/tree/5acf3bba234595fc6404545777c687140b4390be/templates/fs-gg-fable-game/models): Literate svg-arena/arena-rules.md, svg-tactical/tactical-rules.md and svg-replay/energy-rules.md describe arena rule transitions, accepted/predicted/committed tactical state and replay energy dependencies. Arena and tactical directories also contain .qnt rules/correspondence files. Geometry, rendering, transport and pathfinding remain external to these rule models; template source delivery alone does not qualify every generated workspace.
- [S.I.R. rules](https://github.com/EHotwagner/S.I.R./tree/80e1ac9328865ec8d1ee3eeea130560ef22b1b01/docs/rules): Literate sir-combat.md owns the sixteen-rule combat registry, fixed-point formulas and state consequences; its line-of-sight entry is an external algorithm contract. sir-visibility.md separately gives bounded integer supercover and footprint-observation semantics. The learning handbook has literate examples, and tests/fixtures/rules-corpus/quint-q1/sir-damage.qnt is the damage fixture. These public sources do not establish production performance, continuous visibility or current deployment.
- [BAR evidence model](https://github.com/FS-GG/FSBarV2/tree/dbb1b0eb3d3b4c081797e38707d556dabd01ec0c/tests/Broker.NativeProof/RuntimeEvidence/GrowingLogEvidence.qnt): GrowingLogEvidence and its _test module model growing byte prefixes, revision-bound consumption, policy/settlement state, deadlines and sticky invalid/unknown outcomes. Hashes name byte strings under a collision-resistance assumption. This evidence-state model is not engine behavior, a full-image qualification or native game acceptance.
- [Host execution evidence](https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/tree/eebd3a25b841a15831cd6ded2593e8d0eb808ac6/deployment/telemetry-collector): host-attempt/HostAttempt.qnt and its tests model admission/dispatch acknowledgment, ambiguity, deadlines, owned-run retirement and secret cleanup. persistent/v3/image-closure/PersistentV3Runner.qnt and its tests model build identity comparison, qualification and cleanup. They state lifecycle safeguards; they neither settle unknown real effects nor release reservations or authorize a new operation.

Restricted Atlas records and operational receipts remain in their access-restricted archives; this index contains only public source evidence. Future use must retrieve current owner records, verify cited bytes and refresh live facts before acting.
title: Quint model uses and authority boundaries
